decision_conditions:
<div><span style="font-size: 14.6667px; background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">&nbsp;The proposed development, by reason of scale, siting, design, bulk, mass and appearance would be an undesirable addition,&nbsp;representing an overly dominant and excessive addition to the dwelling. The first floor side and rear extension would be significantly visible from public vantage points and would be visually intrusive, represent poor design and would be out of character in the context of the area. In particular, the proposal would not sit comfortably within the existing pattern of development.&nbsp; The accumulative impact of the two storey side and rear extensions will result in the creation of a significantly staggered roof form and over development of the site.&nbsp; As such, the </span>proposed development would be harmful to the appearance of the house, built form of the terrace and character of the area, notably given the location of the application site within the Becontree Estate.
